## Checklist

- [ ] The full test suite passes
- [ ] New or changed behaviour is covered by tests
- [ ] No credentials, `.env`, database files or real backups are included
- [ ] Database changes include a migration
- [ ] Configuration changes are documented in `config.example.yaml` and `.env.example`
- [ ] New endpoints enforce authentication, permission and CSRF protection
- [ ] User-facing strings exist in both English and Persian
- [ ] No new external CDN or runtime dependency was added without discussion
